messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD_INCIDENT#8427 - gpu-memory-pressure (severity: high)
incident-bot: cluster=prod-west, pool=gpu-pool-3, triggered_by=23 cudaAlloc failures in 5m, metric=gpu.mem.used_pct, value=94% -> https://pagerduty.example/incidents/8427
PagerDuty Bot: Incident assigned to schedule: oncall-sre (Maya Chen)
Maya Chen: Acked. I'm on it. Starting initial triage.
Maya Chen: Raj @Raj Patel can you pull node metrics for gpu-pool-3 and check if this is fragmentation vs steady leak?
Raj Patel: pulling prometheus for node: gpu-12,gpu-14,gpu-15 now. Preliminary: gpu-12 mem used spikes align with the cudaAlloc errors.
Tanner Liu: I see repeated kernel failures in the runtime logs on gpu-12 around the same time. Looks like kvcache evictions piled up and then cudaAlloc fails.
Tanner Liu: snippet from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:07:12Z runtime[rt-worker]: WARNING cuda: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory while allocating 2147483648 bytes
2026-03-15T02:07:12Z runtime[rt-worker]: ERROR model-serving: failed to reserve KV cache slot, current_slots=1024, max_slots=1024
2026-03-15T02:07:13Z runtime[rt-worker]: INFO evicting prefix cache 324MB -> reclaimed 0MB (fragmentation)
```
Linda Gomez: Support: we have customer-reports flagging errors for model-infer API in us-west with ~1.8% 500s since 02:05 UTC. Ticketing: INC-5591 created. Customers affected: two mid-market accounts calling large-context generation.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Impact looks limited but not zero. Plan: 1) Isolate offending node (drain gpu-12), 2) failover traffic from gpu-pool-3 to pool-2-fallback (quantized variant), 3) scale up dedicated warm nodes + temporarily enable auto-shedder for very long requests.
Raj Patel: On it. Running kubectl cordon/drain on gpu-12 now. Command: `kubectl cordon gpu-12 && kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
ops-bot: Action: cordon gpu-12 (node/gpu-12) -> success. Evicting pods: rtx-service-5, batch-prewarm-3.
Tanner Liu: I'm patching runtime to clear stale KV handles and reduce kvcache target to 512 slots for pool-3 config. Applying config change to fleet: `/scripts/deploy-config --service=runtime --pool=gpu-pool-3 --kvcache-slots=512`
Tanner Liu: Patch rolled out to 60% of pool-3 nodes. Monitoring for repeat cudaAlloc.
Raj Patel: Autoscaler note: temporary scale-out + maxSurge=2 applied to pool-3 to bring additional empty nodes. Setting `desiredReplicas:+3`.
Linda Gomez: Customer comms: posting provisional note - we're routing around impacted nodes and expect recovery in ~10-15 min. Escalate to customer success if errors persist.
Carlos Vega: Suggest followups: 1) run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.free --format=csv -l 1` across affected nodes to confirm fragmentation, 2) consider kernel param tweak to prefer larger contiguous allocations, 3) postmortem data: sampling KV cache eviction histograms.
Maya Chen: Good checklist. Tanner, Raj - if we still see cudaAlloc after kvcache reduction and node drain, fallback plan is to pause heavy-batching and route new requests to the quantized tiny model (model:gpt-small-q4f16) until pool stabilizes.
Tanner Liu: Pausing heavy-batching via runtime flags now: `PATCH /runtime/config {"enable_batching": false, "batch_max_tokens": 512}` -> applied.
Raj Patel: New nodes joining pool-3; GPU mem used falls to ~45% on newly provisioned nodes. cudaAlloc failures not seen in the last 3m. Prometheus alert count decreasing.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty update: incident#8427 status=acknowledged, responders=Maya Chen, Raj Patel, Tanner Liu. Timeline added.
Maya Chen: Leaving a note: I will hand off at the next rotation (03:30 UTC). Objectives for next oncall: watch for recurrence for 2h, confirm kvcache slot reduction effect, collect `dmesg` from gpu-12 for driver OOM stack traces, and draft a post-incident action item to adjust kvcache heuristics.
Carlos Vega: I'll own the postmortem. Carlos -> create RFC to change default kvcache-to-gpu-mem ratio and run a stresstest in staging.
Linda Gomez: Support: marking affected customer tickets as "mitigated, monitoring". Will reopen if 500s persist.
Maya Chen: Handing off to next oncall @team-sre-rotation. Handoff note: current status=stabilized, mitigation=drain + kvcache reduction + pause batching, followup tasks assigned. ETA for full remediation 48h.
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation policy check: no auto-escalation needed while incident acknowledged.
ops-bot: Automation: attempted restart of rtx-service-5 -> pod recreated on gpu-14 (healthy).
Raj Patel: Last check: 0 cudaAlloc errors in the last 5m window, 500s rate back to baseline 0.2%. Closing incident if stable for 10m.
Maya Chen: I'm going to mark the thread as monitoring. If anything flares, @channel escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Note: follow-up tasks created -> TASK-2981 (collect logs & run kv-frag analysis), TASK-2982 (stresstest kvcache heuristics).
Carlos Vega: Thanks all. Postmortem draft will include timeline and a mitigation runbook for future kvcache fragmentation events.
Maya Chen: Closing handoff. Next check-in scheduled at 03:15 UTC for final close.
